title: Represent dying and death saves for encounter combatants (rule:suffocating, rule:monsters-and-death)
description:
Problem. CombatantStatus has no dying state and no death-save counters; encounterCombatants.ts updateCombatant sets a combatant whose hpDelta reaches 0 to dead unless another status is passed. SRD rule:suffocating makes ANY creature 'drop to 0 hit points and be dying'; SRD rule:monsters-and-death lets the GM have mighty villains and special NPCs 'fall unconscious and follow the same rules as player characters'. Once the DM rules that a combatant follows those rules, the dying lifecycle (death saves, stabilization, damage at 0) is engine-owned and cannot be recorded; 'unconscious' is a lossy substitute. Current disclosure: RULE_KNOWN_LIMITS rule:suffocating with capability gap 'combatant-dying-state'.

Required capability. Operation: an opt-in dying lifecycle for encounter combatants mirroring the character death rules (dying status, death-save success/failure counters, stabilization, damage at 0, instant death on overflow), selected per combatant. Inputs: combatant identity; DM selection that it follows PC death rules. Exclusions: the default monster-dies-at-0 convention stays the default; which combatants follow PC rules is DM interpretation.

Selection basis: the governing SRD clause requires an engine-owned step (ADR 0020 §3: arithmetic / atomic state mutation / resource accounting / lifecycle), and no registered tool performs it. Under F-09 design amendment A5 (docs/design/rule-record-runtime-statements.md, PR #596) the rule's known limit only DISCLOSES this gap; it does not satisfy or retire the obligation. This bead blocks eshyra-o9bd.19.3.4 (owning rules work for opus:F-09 / sol:CAP-001) until the capability lands or accepted authority explicitly changes the requirement. Do not close it because PR #596 recorded the gap. Enters this engine family by explicit positive selection (the family's out-of-backlog entry clause).
acceptance_criteria:
- Combatant dying status + death-save state with deterministic transitions, exposed through update_combatant or a dedicated tool; default behavior unchanged.
- Tests: dying, death saves, stabilization, damage at 0, overflow death, default dead-at-0 preserved.
- rule:suffocating combatant clause rewritten under R0; gap entry removed; update_combatant description updated.
- eshyra-o9bd.19.3.4 dependency resolves only when this lands.
